Title: [Q] Cheating with a Vial of Elder Vitae

Messages.Author: Goratrux
Messages.Body:
1. Can my minion equipped with a Vial of Elder Vitae burn it at any time
?

2. If so, suppose the Vial is burned at the end of my untap phase, and
the minion gains inferior dementation. I then play a Dementation skill
on that minion. Does the minion still have superior Dementation when the
Vial's effect ends?

3. Same question, with a Sanguine Instruction instead of a skill.

4. Same question, but the minion is a Gangrel, the chosen discipline is
Spiritus, and I play Feral Spirit.

Thanks,
Gor

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Goratrux wrote:
>
> 1. Can my minion equipped with a Vial of Elder Vitae burn it at any time
> ?

Yes, you can burn it at any time.

> 2. If so, suppose the Vial is burned at the end of my untap phase, and
> the minion gains inferior dementation. I then play a Dementation skill
> on that minion. Does the minion still have superior Dementation when the
> Vial's effect ends?

Nah. Errata (new): The Vial increases your level of the Chosen Discipline
by one until your next untap phase. Discipline levels: 0 (no Discipline),
1 (normal), and 2 (superior).

> 3. Same question, with a Sanguine Instruction instead of a skill.

No, by the same new errata above.

> 4. Same question, but the minion is a Gangrel, the chosen discipline is
> Spiritus, and I play Feral Spirit.

No, by the same new errata.

--

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>On a similiar note, Can a vampire equipped with one of the items that give a
>superior discipline (Changeling skin mask) perform Sanguine Instruction?

Yes. Delilah Easton with a Changeling Skin Mask does have superior Obfuscate,
so she fulfills the requirements of playing Sanguine Instruction (for
Obfuscate).

Halcyan 2
